stem: Which lines from the poem “Going Home (Burlington Route)” use figurative language to build a sense of happiness?

options.label: A
options.text: The sharp curves and windings left behind, The roadway wide open, (lines 4–5)

options.label: B
options.text: (The crooked straight And the rough places plain.) (lines 6–7)

options.label: C
options.text: I open my window and let the air blow in, The air of morning, (lines 11–12)

options.label: D
options.text: They spin bright along the bright rails, Singing and humming, (lines 20–21)
